tasks.title: Extract and enhance ModelSelect as a shared component
tasks.description: Move the embedded ModelSelect from AiSettingsSection.tsx into a new components/ModelSelect.tsx file. Add a size prop ('default' | 'compact') and support both Model[] and string[] for the models prop. When models is string[], auto-convert each entry to {id, name: id.split('/').pop()}. Keep all existing behavior (search, keyboard navigation, provider grouping, clear button) intact.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelSelect.tsx exists and exports the ModelSelect component
Component accepts size='default' | 'compact' and models as Model[] | string[]
Settings page still compiles and typechecks after removal of the embedded component

tasks.title: Update AiSettingsSection to import the shared ModelSelect
tasks.description: Remove the embedded ModelSelect function and its internal icon components from AiSettingsSection.tsx. Import the shared ModelSelect component instead. Ensure all existing call sites (Mohist Model, Coder Model, and per-stage overrides in Settings) continue to work with the same props.
acceptanceCriteria: AiSettingsSection.tsx no longer contains an embedded ModelSelect definition
Settings page model selectors render and function correctly

tasks.title: Refactor IssueModelSelector per-stage overrides to use ModelSelect
tasks.description: Replace the per-stage Popover + Transition implementation in IssueModelSelector.tsx with the shared ModelSelect component using size='compact'. Preserve the existing handleSetStageModel and handleClearStageModel logic. Keep the main Coder Model selector unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-stage dropdowns open and display correctly when clicked
Search, keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter), and provider grouping work in per-stage dropdowns
Selecting a model updates stageModels via PATCH /api/issues/:number
Clearing a model removes the stage override
